text:
There is no worry except when hungry; no service except an enemy's; no savor except a hay bale; no vigilance except a sleeping man's; no mercy except treason's; no safety except cowards'; no loyalty except the reformed man's; none wiser than the lover.

No begetting except in baths; no good fame except a shamed man's; no laughter except after a blow; no prestige except after denying debts; no true love except flattery; no good meeting except with wretches; no true report except a lie; none wiser than the lover.

No rest like living worried; no greater honor than saying bah; no vainglory except counterfeiters'; no health except a bloated man's; no high daring except cowardice; no reason except rage's; no sweetness except in a dazed woman; none wiser than the lover.

Would you hear the truth? No game except in sickness; no true word except in tragedy; no coward except the chivalrous; no horrible sound except melody; none wiser than the lover.

translation.title: Ballad of Counter-Truths
